name: kraxyy-apply-monorepo
description: Kraxyy Apply - Production-ready job application automation platform

scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:services && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:web: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/web run build
scripts.build:api: npm run build:packages && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/matching run build && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/job-ingestion run build && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/api run build
scripts.build:packages: npm --workspace=@kraxyy/types run build && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/shared run build && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/validation run build
scripts.build:services: npm --workspace=@kraxyy/job-ingestion run build && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/matching run build && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/d1-worker run build && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/api run build
scripts.build:apps: npm --workspace=@kraxyy/web run build && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/admin run build && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/extension run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace=@kraxyy/api run test && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/extension run test && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/job-ingestion run test && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/matching run test && npm --workspace=@kraxyy/d1-worker run test
